items.difficulty_reason: For each site the proof identifies the localized categories concretely (X_lisse-etale/x vs (Sch/U)_etale and its smooth subcategory; flat-fppf analogously) so that the Etale Cohomology compare-structure-sheaves lemma applies to the comparison equation, and the module-level g_! agrees with the abelian-sheaf one; g^*g_! = id follows from g^* = g^{-1} and the abelian equality.
